title: NOPE, skip it! HUGE design flaw!
text:
NOPE, skip it! HUGE design flaw!. The big design flaw of this thing is that the filter inside of the canister is surrounded by plastic but there's a humongous uncovered hole above the filter! So when you vacuum, hair and everything gets sucked into the hole and just covers your filter! So each time I vacuum I have to pull that silly filter out and clean it, it makes so much extra work for me! I'm going to have to run to the home improvement store and hope I can find some foam to put around that piece and keep hair and such out of the filter. Other vacuums I've bought use a foam part around the filter to prevent this so this is a big oversight on their part.

Filter clogging aside, this thing does have plenty of suction to it and works pretty well! I love the base it comes with- I can just put it on the base and it charges it! I'll be keeping this vacuum and do like it, just gotta fix the filter issue.
